P.text: GTELaunchpadV2Pair has rewards accrual enabled and has accrued launchpad fees (accruedLaunchpadFee0/accruedLaunchpadFee1); _reserve0/_reserve1 already account for accrued fees while balance0/balance1 can contain them.
P.evidence_quote: The issue arises because `_reserve0` and `_reserve1` already account for `accruedLaunchpadFee0` and `accruedLaunchpadFee1` (as you can see in the `_update()` function in the `Root Cause` section below), while `balance0` and `balance1` can contain these accrued fees.

I.text: mint(), swap(), and burn() must properly account for accrued launchpad fees when calculating token amounts.
I.evidence_quote: These functions fail to properly account for accrued launchpad fees (`accruedLaunchpadFee0` and `accruedLaunchpadFee1`) when calculating token amounts.

V.text: Accounting bugs in mint(), swap(), and burn() allow attackers to mint liquidity for free, swap out tokens for free without transferring in tokens, and extract more value than entitled, stealing locked assets and draining the pool.
V.evidence_quote: These functions fail to properly account for accrued launchpad fees when calculating token amounts, allowing attackers to steal locked assets from the pair.
